LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 7.1.1 SOCIALISING AND TAKING ACTION: DEBATES AND DISCUSSI

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 7.1: Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Socialising and Taking Action: Debates and Discussi

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Socialising and Taking Action: Debates and Discussi. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do we demonstrate attentive listening?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify vocabulary from a story for comprehension
2. construct sentences using vocabulary and adverbs correctly for expression

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 7.1.1 SOCIALISING AND TAKING ACTION: DEBATES AND DISCUSSI
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES · Grade: Grade 6
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Socialising and Taking Action: Debates and Discussi helps you succeed in INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 7.1.1 SOCIALISING AND TAKING ACTION: DEBATES AND DISCUSSI
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Identify vocabulary from a story for comprehension

What this means
In this part you learn to identify vocabulary from a story for comprehension. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify vocabulary from a story for comprehension.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Socialising and Taking Action: Debates and Discussi”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify vocabulary from a story for comprehension. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Construct sentences using vocabulary and adverbs correctly for expression

What this means
In this part you learn to construct sentences using vocabulary and adverbs correctly for expression. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: construct sentences using vocabulary and adverbs correctly for expression.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Socialising and Taking Action: Debates and Discussi to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can construct sentences using vocabulary and adverbs correctly for expression. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Socialising and Taking Action: Debates and Discussi is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Socialising and Taking Action: Debates and Discussi”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: identify vocabulary from a story for comprehension)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Socialising and Taking Action: Debates and Discussi to a partner. (skill: construct sentences using vocabulary and adverbs correctly for expression)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Socialising and Taking Action: Debates and Discussi to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify vocabulary from a story for comprehension.
3. Practise this skill: construct sentences using vocabulary and adverbs correctly for expression.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Socialising and Taking Action: Debates and Discussi from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Socialising and Taking Action: Debates and Discussi: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 6 learner study Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Socialising and Taking Action: Debates and Discussi?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we demonstrate attentive listening?
2. When do we use adverbs?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Socialising and Taking Action: Debates and Discussi means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify vocabulary from a story for comprehension.
5. Be able to: construct sentences using vocabulary and adverbs correctly for expression.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
